title: Classification of irreducible highest weight modules for the parafermion vertex algebras $N_k(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$ at arbitrary level
summary: Let $N^k(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$ be the universal parafermion vertex algebra and $N_k(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$ its simple quotient. We classify all irreducible highest weight $N^k(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$-modules for every $k\neq 0$. We give a presentation of Zhu's algebra $A(N^k(\mathfrak{sl}_2))$ as a quotient of a polynomial algebra in four variables by an ideal generated by three explicit polynomials. This presentation also shows that $A(N^k(\mathfrak{sl}_2))$ is a free module of rank three over the polynomial subalgebra generated by the classes of the fields of weights two and three.
